Container.Name: Hikidashi-Worker
Container.Overview: Transcribes, reads the text on screen, tags and finds recipes for each new reel, on the CPU. Tagging and recipes call Ollama: install Unraid's Ollama app, or set Stages to asr,ocr.[br][br]Give it exactly the same Data path as Hikidashi. For a GPU, use Hikidashi-Worker-CUDA instead; never both on one library unless each has its own Stages.
Container.Requires: Hikidashi and Hikidashi-Server-Worker, on the same Data path.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Exactly Hikidashi's Data path. A pool, never /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Stages
Config.Description: Of asr, ocr, tag and recipe. asr,ocr when a GPU desktop tags for this box, or when there is no Ollama.

Config.Name: Ollama URL
Config.Description: The Ollama that tag and recipe call: Unraid's Ollama app on this server, with its port 11434 published, by default.

Config.Name: Profile
Config.Description: The models: cpu, or auto to pick from the hardware.

Config.Name: Unload after
Config.Description: Seconds with no work before Whisper is unloaded.

Config.Name: Log to syslog
Config.Description: Also send the log to a syslog server, as udp://192.168.1.10:514 (Unraid's own, under Settings, Syslog Server). Empty: off.

Config.Name: Log to Loki
Config.Description: Also push the log to Loki, as http://192.168.1.10:3100. Empty: off.

Config.Name: Loki token
Config.Description: A bearer token for Loki, if it asks for one.
